name: key_rotation_compromise_exposure_cost
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local key-rotation policy. Day 1 starts with a fresh key active. The key rotates at the end of every {N}-th day (end of day {N}, 2x{N}, ...); records on a rotation day use the outgoing key, and the new key covers the next day onward. The active key is compromised on day {C}, exposing every record encrypted with it from the day after its last rotation through day {C} inclusive. Day 1 has {R} records; each later day has {D} more than the prior day (negative means fewer). Cost per exposed record is {C_CENTS} US cents. A regulatory adjustment of {S} basis points of the base exposure cost is then added (negative reduces it). Report exposure window days, exposed records, base cost in USD, and total exposure cost in USD.

slots.description: Number of days in the exposure window including the compromise day
Total records encrypted during the exposure window
Exposure cost in USD before the basis-point adjustment

program:
def solve():
    N = P["N"]
    C = P["C"]
    R = P["R"]
    D = P["D"]
    cents = Fraction(str(P["C_CENTS"]))
    S = P["S"]
    last_rotation = ((C - 1) // N) * N
    days = C - last_rotation
    records = 0
    for d in range(last_rotation + 1, C + 1):
        daily = R + D * (d - 1)
        if daily < 0:
            raise ValueError("negative daily record volume in window")
        records += daily
    base_cost = Fraction(records) * cents / 100
    total = base_cost * (1 + Fraction(S, 10000))
    return {"final": total, "exposure_days": Fraction(days), "exposed_records": Fraction(records), "base_cost_usd": base_cost}
